jp: 知られざる父、私たちの原父である《深淵のプロパトル》のことだね。私たちでも「永遠に誰にも知ることができない超越存在」ということしか知らないよ。そういうものだと私たちはなんとか納得していたが、当時のソピアーは納得できなかった。叡智を司るのに自分の父のこともわからないというのは気が狂うほどのストレスだったようだね。
jp_grezzo: "知られざる父、私たちの原父である《深淵のプロパトル》のことだね。私たちでも「永遠に誰にも知ることができない超越存在」ということしか知らないよ。そういうものだと私たちはなんとか納得していたが、当時のソピアーは納得できなかった。叡智を司るのに自分の父のこともわからないというのは気が狂うほどのストレスだったようだね。"
en: The father that <Sophia> is referring to is our primordial father, <Bythos Propater>. All we know is that He is a transcendent being that will never be known by anyone. We somehow managed to convince ourselves that this was the way it was, but <Sophia> at the time couldn't accept it. It must have been insanely stressful to be in charge of wisdom yet not know anything about own father.
en_grezzo: "The father that <Sophia> is referring to is our primordial father, <Bythos Propater>. All we know is that He is a transcendent being that will never be known by anyone. We somehow managed to convince ourselves that this was the way it was, but <Sophia> at the time couldn't accept it. It must have been insanely stressful to be in charge of wisdom yet not know anything about own father."
it: Parli del padre ignoto, del nostro primo padre: <Propator dell'Abisso>. Anche noi ne sappiamo una cosa sola, che è \"un essere trascendente che nessuno potrà mai conoscere, in eterno\". Noi in qualche modo ci siamo rassegnati; Sophia, allora, non ci riuscì. Avere in mano la sapienza e non sapere niente del proprio padre: dev'essere stata un'angoscia da impazzire.

jp: 君に渡しておきたいものがあるんだ。
jp_grezzo: "君に渡しておきたいものがあるんだ。"
en: I've got something for you.
en_grezzo: "I've got something for you."
it: C'è una cosa che voglio darti.

jp: [エルシアの首飾り]と[クイーン・セドナの乗船券]を手に入れた！
jp_grezzo: "[エルシアの首飾り]と[クイーン・セドナの乗船券]を手に入れた！"
en: You obtain the [Elsian Necklace] and a [Boarding Ticket for the Queen Sedona]!
en_grezzo: "You obtain the [Elsian Necklace] and a [Boarding Ticket for the Queen Sedona]!"
it: Ottieni la [collana di Elsia] e il [biglietto per la <Regina Sedona>]!

jp: これらは、ボクがこの地でガイドした最後の旅人の持ち物だ。最後のループで、最期にボクに託された。
jp_grezzo: "これらは、ボクがこの地でガイドした最後の旅人の持ち物だ。最後のループで、最期にボクに託された。"
en: These were the belongings of the last traveler I ever guided in this land. They were entrusted to me at the end of the final loop.
en_grezzo: "These were the belongings of the last traveler I ever guided in this land. They were entrusted to me at the end of the final loop."
it: Appartenevano all'ultimo viandante che ho guidato in questa terra. Nell'ultimo ciclo, in fin di vita, me li ha affidati.

jp: 何の役にも立たないだろう。それでも君に持っていてほしい。これらを持つにふさわしいのは、君しかいないと思うから。
jp_grezzo: "何の役にも立たないだろう。それでも君に持っていてほしい。これらを持つにふさわしいのは、君しかいないと思うから。"
en: They'll probably be of no use to you. Still, I want you to take them, because I believe you're the only person deserving of them.
en_grezzo: "They'll probably be of no use to you. Still, I want you to take them, because I believe you're the only person deserving of them."
it: Non ti serviranno a niente, probabilmente. Eppure voglio che li tenga tu, perché non conosco nessun altro che li meriti.

jp: 頑張って
jp_grezzo: "頑張って"
en: Good luck.
en_grezzo: "Good luck."
it: In bocca al lupo.

jp: なんか恥ずかしいな
jp_grezzo: "なんか恥ずかしいな"
en: This is a bit embarassing.
en_grezzo: "This is a bit embarassing."
it: Che imbarazzo.

jp: おい馬鹿やめろ
jp_grezzo: "おい馬鹿やめろ"
en: Knock it off, idiot.
en_grezzo: "Knock it off, idiot."
it: Ehi, piantala, scemo.

jp: 無言で腹を殴る
jp_grezzo: "無言で腹を殴る"
en: (Punch him in the gut without saying a word.)
en_grezzo: "(Punch him in the gut without saying a word.)"
it: (Un pugno nello stomaco, senza dire niente.)

jp: …じゃあボクはイルヴァの民達にガイアス・ヴィスの話をしてくるよ。ああ、そうだ！ついでに君が混沌と戦うことも君の知り合いたちに教えてあげよう！
jp_grezzo: "…じゃあボクはイルヴァの民達にガイアス・ヴィスの話をしてくるよ。ああ、そうだ！ついでに君が混沌と戦うことも君の知り合いたちに教えてあげよう！"
en: ...I'll go tell the people of Irva about Gaius Vis. Oh, yeah! And while I'm at it, I'll tell everyone you know about your fight against Chaos!
en_grezzo: "...I'll go tell the people of Irva about Gaius Vis. Oh, yeah! And while I'm at it, I'll tell everyone you know about your fight against Chaos!"
it: ...Bene, io vado a raccontare di Gaius Vis alla gente di Irva. Ah, giusto! E già che ci sono dirò a tutti quelli che conosci che ti batti contro il Caos!

jp: ぶぎぇっ！？何するのさ！
jp_grezzo: "ぶぎぇっ！？何するのさ" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "！"
en: Gurk! *cough* *cough*... What are you doing, ?
en_grezzo: "Gurk! *cough* *cough*... What are you doing, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "?"
contesto: chatMore lang("ぶぎぇっ！？何するのさ" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "！", "Gurk! *cough* *cough*... What are you doing, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "?")
it: "Bgheh?! Ma che fai, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "?!"

jp: 君は今！ガイアス・ヴィスへの第一歩を踏み出した！
jp_grezzo: "君は今！ガイアス・ヴィスへの第一歩を踏み出した！"
en: You have - right now! - taken your first step into Gaius Vis!
en_grezzo: "You have - right now! - taken your first step into Gaius Vis!"
it: Ecco! In questo istante hai messo piede per la prima volta a Gaius Vis!

jp: ここまで長かった…この世界ではまだ1年程度しか経っていないけれど、ボクはループ込みで10年以上対応にあたっていたんだ。ようやく君という因子を見つけて連れてくることができたよ。
jp_grezzo: "ここまで長かった…この世界ではまだ1年程度しか経っていないけれど、ボクはループ込みで10年以上対応にあたっていたんだ。ようやく君という因子を見つけて連れてくることができたよ。"
en: It's taken me so long to get to this point... In this world it has only been about a year, but because of the loops, I've been dealing with this for over 10 years by now. Finally, I've managed to find you, the Decisive Factor, and brought you here.
en_grezzo: "It's taken me so long to get to this point... In this world it has only been about a year, but because of the loops, I've been dealing with this for over 10 years by now. Finally, I've managed to find you, the Decisive Factor, and brought you here."
it: Quanta strada... In questo mondo è passato sì e no un anno, ma io, contando i cicli, ci lavoro da più di dieci. Alla fine il Fattore Decisivo l'ho trovato, e sei tu: e sono riuscito a portarti qui.

jp: うーん。でもまだ君の認識が次元を超えて追いついていないみたいだね。おそらく君の目には、多くのものがイルヴァのものに置き換わって見えるだろう。
jp_grezzo: "うーん。でもまだ君の認識が次元を超えて追いついていないみたいだね。おそらく君の目には、多くのものがイルヴァのものに置き換わって見えるだろう。"
en: Hmmm... But it seems that your perception has not caught up with you across dimensions yet. Perhaps, in your eyes, many things here will appear to be replaced by things you've seen in Irva.
en_grezzo: "Hmmm... But it seems that your perception has not caught up with you across dimensions yet. Perhaps, in your eyes, many things here will appear to be replaced by things you've seen in Irva."
it: Mmh. Però la tua percezione non ha ancora seguito il salto fra le dimensioni. Probabilmente ai tuoi occhi molte cose appariranno sostituite da cose di Irva.

jp: さて…見る限り、依然として廃忘獣がはびこっているようだね…。あのお方は大丈夫だろうか。一緒に探しに行こう！
jp_grezzo: "さて…見る限り、依然として廃忘獣がはびこっているようだね…。あのお方は大丈夫だろうか。一緒に探しに行こう！"
en: Well... as far as I can see, it seems this place is still crawling with oblivion beasts... I wonder if that girl is okay. Let's go look for her together!
en_grezzo: "Well... as far as I can see, it seems this place is still crawling with oblivion beasts... I wonder if that girl is okay. Let's go look for her together!"
it: Dunque... a quanto vedo, le bestie dell'oblio dilagano ancora... Chissà se quella persona sta bene. Andiamo a cercarla insieme!

jp: えっ。あのお方が誰かって？ああ、まだ説明してなかったっけ。
jp_grezzo: "えっ。あのお方が誰かって？ああ、まだ説明してなかったっけ。"
en: Eh? Who's \"that girl\", you say? Oh, right. I haven't explained that part yet.
en_grezzo: "Eh? Who's \"that girl\", you say? Oh, right. I haven't explained that part yet."
it: Eh? Chi sarebbe \"quella persona\", dici? Ah, giusto: non te l'ho ancora spiegato.

jp: 叡智を司る中級神であるソピアーは知っているよね。あのお方はソピアーの兄姉たち28柱が合神した、超越神だよ。幾多の神々を吸収した混沌の神に対抗するための措置だったらしいね。ちなみにソピアーは一回堕天している影響でうまく合神できなかったんだって。
jp_grezzo: "叡智を司る中級神であるソピアーは知っているよね。あのお方はソピアーの兄姉たち28柱が合神した、超越神だよ。幾多の神々を吸収した混沌の神に対抗するための措置だったらしいね。ちなみにソピアーは一回堕天している影響でうまく合神できなかったんだって。"
en: You know Sophia, the mid-tier god who controls wisdom, right? The girl I'm talking about is a transcendent deity who is a combination of twenty-eight of Sophia's brothers and sisters. I heard that the reason for that was to be able to stand against the God of Chaos, who'd absorbed many other gods himself. By the way, I also heard that Sophia couldn't combine all those gods properly because of her fall from the heavens.
en_grezzo: "You know Sophia, the mid-tier god who controls wisdom, right? The girl I'm talking about is a transcendent deity who is a combination of twenty-eight of Sophia's brothers and sisters. I heard that the reason for that was to be able to stand against the God of Chaos, who'd absorbed many other gods himself. By the way, I also heard that Sophia couldn't combine all those gods properly because of her fall from the heavens."
it: Sophia la conosci, no? La divinità di medio rango che ha in mano la sapienza. Ebbene, quella persona è un dio trascendente: ventotto fra i fratelli e le sorelle di Sophia, fusi in uno solo. Pare fosse una contromisura contro il dio del Caos, che di divinità ne aveva assorbite parecchie. E pare che Sophia, per via di quella volta che cadde dal cielo, nella fusione non sia riuscita a entrare bene.

jp: あのお方はガイアス・ヴィスの実情を知って、色々と便宜を図ってくれた。今は直接、忘却の女神と戦っているはずだ。こうしてボクが覚えている以上、間違いなく無事なはずなんだけど…。
jp_grezzo: "あのお方はガイアス・ヴィスの実情を知って、色々と便宜を図ってくれた。今は直接、忘却の女神と戦っているはずだ。こうしてボクが覚えている以上、間違いなく無事なはずなんだけど…。"
en: That fine lady knew the actual situation of Gaius Vis, and did a lot to help us. She must be fighting the Goddess of Oblivion herself as we speak. As long as I can remember her like I'm doing right now, she should be safe, but...
en_grezzo: "That fine lady knew the actual situation of Gaius Vis, and did a lot to help us. She must be fighting the Goddess of Oblivion herself as we speak. As long as I can remember her like I'm doing right now, she should be safe, but..."
it: Quella persona ha saputo com'è ridotta Gaius Vis, e ci ha agevolati in molti modi. Adesso dovrebbe essere in prima linea contro la dea dell'oblio. E finché io me ne ricordo così, come adesso, vuol dire per forza che sta bene. Almeno, dovrebbe...

jp: 一度引き返したい場合は、こちら側のロイターを経由してね。そこの炭鉱街…ザイールにいるはずだから。
jp_grezzo: "一度引き返したい場合は、こちら側のロイターを経由してね。そこの炭鉱街…ザイールにいるはずだから。"
en: If you want to head back, you'll have to talk to the Loyter on this side. He should be in the coal mining town of Zaile just nearby.
en_grezzo: "If you want to head back, you'll have to talk to the Loyter on this side. He should be in the coal mining town of Zaile just nearby."
it: Se a un certo punto vuoi tornare indietro, passa dal Loyter di questo lato. Dovrebbe stare nella città mineraria qui vicino... Zaile.

jp: そうそう、君に渡しておくものがあった。
jp_grezzo: "そうそう、君に渡しておくものがあった。"
en: Oh yeah, I have something to give you.
en_grezzo: "Oh yeah, I have something to give you."
it: Ah, giusto: avevo una cosa da darti.

jp: [記憶の灯]を手に入れた！
jp_grezzo: "[記憶の灯]を手に入れた！"
en: You obtain the [Light of Memory]!
en_grezzo: "You obtain the [Light of Memory]!"
it: Ottieni il [lume della memoria]!

jp: それは生命情報を記録するアストラル光の塊。記憶をバックアップしてくれるから、記憶消去攻撃を受けてもかなり軽減できるらしいよ。
jp_grezzo: "それは生命情報を記録するアストラル光の塊。記憶をバックアップしてくれるから、記憶消去攻撃を受けてもかなり軽減できるらしいよ。"
en: That's a mass of astral light that records life information. Because it backs up your memories, even if you suffer from a memory erasure attack, its effects should be considerably reduced.
en_grezzo: "That's a mass of astral light that records life information. Because it backs up your memories, even if you suffer from a memory erasure attack, its effects should be considerably reduced."
it: È una massa di luce astrale che registra le informazioni della vita. Tiene una copia dei ricordi, quindi pare che attutisca parecchio gli attacchi che cancellano la memoria.

jp: さらに、世界を行き来するための道具でもあるんだ。ロイターに向かって使ってみて。現時点で、彼は誰よりもガイアス・ヴィスとの結びつきが強い。あちら側にも極めて近い存在がいるんだ。記憶の灯はその繋がりを照らして導いてくれるよ。
jp_grezzo: "さらに、世界を行き来するための道具でもあるんだ。ロイターに向かって使ってみて。現時点で、彼は誰よりもガイアス・ヴィスとの結びつきが強い。あちら側にも極めて近い存在がいるんだ。記憶の灯はその繋がりを照らして導いてくれるよ。"
en: Moreover, it's also a tool for traveling between worlds. Try using it while facing Loyter. At the moment, he is more tied to Gaius Vis than anyone else. There is also a very similar existence to him on the other side. The light from your memories will illuminate that connection and guide you through to the other world.
en_grezzo: "Moreover, it's also a tool for traveling between worlds. Try using it while facing Loyter. At the moment, he is more tied to Gaius Vis than anyone else. There is also a very similar existence to him on the other side. The light from your memories will illuminate that connection and guide you through to the other world."
it: E poi è anche uno strumento per andare da un mondo all'altro. Prova a usarlo rivolto verso Loyter: al momento non c'è nessuno legato a Gaius Vis più di lui. Anche dall'altra parte esiste qualcuno che gli somiglia moltissimo, e il lume della memoria illumina quel legame e ti ci porta.
